Why you can be spiritual and wealthy at the same time.

Kevin explains that spirituality and money are not opposites. In his words, a person can be compassionate, full of love and highly evolved, and still be wealthy.

He calls the idea that you must choose one or the other a false split. Being good and having abundance can go together.

Which belief about money did you pick up growing up?
